rationale.ngl_99: Single dense 9B Q6_K fits fully on 12GB; models-max 1 law.
rationale.ctx_65536: Hermes agent multi-tool floor is 64k context.
rationale.kv_q8_0: Canon-safe KV quant; large VRAM win vs f16; avoid q4_0 (tunnel vision).
rationale.kv_offload: Overflow KV pages to system RAM (128GB) without dual-GPU residents.
rationale.mmap: Map weights; leave free RAM for OS/RDP/Discord/Comfy coexistence.
rationale.no_mlock: mlock would pin multi-GB and fight the memory bus under RDP load.
rationale.batch_512_ubatch_256: Lower prefill peaks on 3060 vs defaults 2048/512.
rationale.parallel_1: One slot; dual parallel exploded KV OOM historically on 65k.

budget.image_stack: release Comfy before LLM heal (12GB law)
